notes: 12 The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

quotes.text: Fourthly-Judgment. Psalm 89:14: "Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne." Deuteronomy 32:4: "He is the Rock, his work is perfect; for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he." Psalm 9:7: "But the Lord shall endure for ever. He hath prepared his throne for judgment." Psalm 9:16: "The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth.
quotes.attr: Craig J. Ostler and Joseph fielding Mc Conkie, Revelations of the Restoration

notes: Psalms 89:23 23 And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
37 It shall be established for ever as the moon, and [as] a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
50 Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; [how] I do bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the mighty people;
This psalm was composed by Moses, the man of God, some time after God had sentenced the Hebrews to wandering and death in the wilderness, Num. 14.
